description: Tournai - Bornes de réparation Vélo is a dataset listed in Tournai open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Administration Communale de Tournai. Localisation des bornes de réparation vélos sur l'entité de Tournai. Coverage: Tournai. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Tournai, mobilité, vélo. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-03-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-tournai-portal.
